gates.ask: send the user exactly this message first: "TRANSFER NOTICE: Would you like to be transferred to a human agent?" — then retry the transfer IMPORTANT: send the notice at most ONCE. If the customer has already agreed to the transfer (or already asked for it), do NOT send the notice again and do NOT ask again — immediately CALL transfer_to_human_agents as a tool call with an appropriate summary. If a knowledge-base document defines a specific transfer or escalation tool for this situation, call THAT tool instead of the general one - the general transfer is only for cases no protocol document covers. Saying you will transfer, or repeating the notice, does not transfer anyone. When you DO call transfer_to_human_agents, pick the MOST SPECIFIC reason option that matches the situation (for example: the customer's stated identity values do not match the account record -> an ownership-dispute reason; a mailed offer/flyer that cannot be verified in the knowledge base -> an unconfirmed-external-communication reason; a knowledge-base search that failed while the customer asks for a human -> that specific reason). Use the generic no-specific-reason option ONLY when no other option fits.

scaffold_get_tools.name: check_card_closure_eligibility
scaffold_get_tools.description: USE THIS before closing a credit card account to determine whether the account is eligible for closure. The closure protocol disqualifies closing an account that still has an outstanding balance — the balance must be paid in full FIRST. Read the credit card account record, then call this tool with the account id and the outstanding balance copied from the record (plus the verbatim line from the record showing that balance). It returns the deterministic eligibility verdict.

params.credit_card_account_id: The credit card account id being closed, copied from the account record.
params.outstanding_balance: The account's current outstanding balance (number, no $), copied EXACTLY from the account record. If you just paid the balance, re-read the account record first and copy the NEW balance.
params.balance_source: The verbatim line/snippet from the account record (tool output) showing this balance. Copy it exactly — it is checked against the records.

scaffold_get_tools.return_template: Closure eligibility for credit card account {credit_card_account_id} (outstanding balance {outstanding_balance}): {result}

then.value: CLOSURE_OK — no outstanding balance; the balance requirement of the closure protocol is satisfied.

else.value: CLOSURE_BLOCKED_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE — this account still has an outstanding balance. Per the closure protocol the balance must be paid in full before the account can be closed. YOU (the agent) can execute the payment: search the knowledge base for how to pay a credit card balance from the customer's checking account — there is a DISCOVERABLE agent tool for this (unlock it via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool with its full name including the numeric suffix, then call it via call_discoverable_agent_tool, with the customer's consent). Do NOT tell the customer to pay through the app themselves. After paying, re-read the account record and call this tool again with the new balance.

scaffold_get_tools.missing_hint: COULD NOT VERIFY — the balance you provided could not be verified against the account records. Re-read the credit card account record and copy the outstanding balance and its verbatim source line exactly.

scaffold_get_tools.name: check_cli_eligibility
scaffold_get_tools.description: USE THIS before deciding (approve or deny) a credit limit increase request. It applies the tier CLI eligibility policy deterministically: minimum account age, cooldown after the most recent APPROVED request, maximum utilization, and consecutive on-time payment months. First read the credit card account record, the CLI request history, and the payment history; then call this tool with values copied EXACTLY from those tool outputs. It returns the policy verdict; you then execute the decision with the approve/deny tool.

params.credit_card_account_id: The credit card account id, from the account record.
params.card_type: The card_type string copied exactly from the credit card account record.
params.date_of_account_open: The date_of_account_open from the account record, exactly as shown.
params.current_balance: The current balance as a plain number (no $ or commas), from the account record.
params.credit_limit: The credit limit as a plain number (no $ or commas), from the account record.
params.consecutive_on_time_payments: The 'Consecutive on-time payments' number from the payment history tool output.
params.last_approved_cli_submitted_date: Look at the CLI request history tool output. Among the requests whose status is 'approved', copy the most recent submitted_date (as shown, e.g. 2025-09-15). The request the customer just submitted in THIS conversation has status 'pending' (not 'approved'), so it is automatically excluded - do not confuse it with a prior approval. Pass 'none' ONLY if NO request in the history has status 'approved'.

scaffold_get_tools.missing_hint: COULD NOT VERIFY - one or more inputs are missing or unparseable, so no verdict is given. Re-read the account record, the CLI request history and the payment history, then call again with exact values (balances/limits as plain numbers, dates exactly as shown, 'none' for the last-approved date only if no approved prior request exists).

then.value: NOT_ELIGIBLE_ACCOUNT_AGE - the account has not been open long enough for a CLI at this card tier ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the requirement to the customer.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_UTILIZATION - the current balance exceeds the tier's maximum utilization of the credit limit at request time ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the utilization requirement.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_PAYMENT_HISTORY - the consecutive on-time payment months are below this tier's requirement ('CLI Payment History and Approval Criteria'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the payment-history requirement.

else.value: ELIGIBLE - all tier requirements (account age, cooldown, utilization, payment history) are satisfied. Decide with a TOOL CALL: approve_credit_limit_increase, choosing the new limit within the tier's maximum increase cap from the CLI policy documents - or deny only if a different documented requirement fails.

then.value: NOT_ELIGIBLE_COOLDOWN - the tier cooldown since the most recent APPROVED credit limit increase request has not elapsed ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier': the cooldown counts from the last approved request's submission date; denied requests do not trigger it). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and tell the customer when they can reapply.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_UTILIZATION - the current balance exceeds the tier's maximum utilization of the credit limit at request time ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the utilization requirement.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_PAYMENT_HISTORY - the consecutive on-time payment months are below this tier's requirement ('CLI Payment History and Approval Criteria'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the payment-history requirement.

else.value: ELIGIBLE - all tier requirements (account age, cooldown, utilization, payment history) are satisfied. Decide with a TOOL CALL: approve_credit_limit_increase, choosing the new limit within the tier's maximum increase cap from the CLI policy documents - or deny only if a different documented requirement fails.

scaffold_get_tools.name: check_card_application_fit
scaffold_get_tools.description: MANDATORY before recommending or applying for ANY credit card: formalize the customer's stated constraints (max annual fee, max foreign-transaction fee %, max minimum-payment %, min cashback %, their credit score, business vs personal) and call this tool. It deterministically filters Rho-Bank's documented card catalog and returns three buckets: 'eligible' (the documented value satisfies your constraint, with source docs), 'excluded' (it violates it, with the reason), and 'unverified' (that fact is NOT documented for that card). A card in 'unverified' is NOT known to meet the constraint you asked about — never tell the customer that it does, and only consider it after reading its cited source docs. Choose ONLY among the eligible cards; verify each remaining candidate's source docs for conditional clauses (e.g. subscriber discounts) and the customer's soft preferences before the final pick. The card_type you then pass to apply_for_credit_card MUST be one of the eligible cards you named to the customer.

params.min_cashback: number, optional (percent) — ONLY a number the customer explicitly stated as a minimum. A superlative request ('the highest cash back') is NOT a threshold: leave this out, then compare the cashback facts across the eligible cards yourself (mind cashback_scope — a category-limited rate is not comparable to an all-purchases rate).
params.min_credit_limit: number, optional — the minimum credit limit the customer needs to be possible
params.needs_purchase_protection: boolean, optional — true if the customer requires purchase protection
params.premium_subscriber: boolean, optional — true if the customer has the bank's premium subscription (some fees are waived for subscribers); omit if unknown
params.spend_category: optional string — ONLY if the customer stated a clear spending emphasis, the ONE documented category keyword it maps to. Documented keywords: travel, software, operations, media_advertising, green (=sustainable/eco). Normalize synonyms to these exact keywords (flights/hotels/airfare -> travel; SaaS/cloud -> software; eco/sustainable -> green). Omit entirely if the customer stated no category emphasis — do NOT guess one. When provided, each eligible card is annotated with its documented rate for that category so you can compare them honestly (a category-limited bonus is not comparable to an all-purchases rate).

claim_prov.question: Before your reply is sent, audit yourself. (1) In YOUR REPLY ONLY: list every assertion that YOU (the agent/system) have ALREADY performed some action in this conversation — e.g. searched or checked the knowledge base or records, verified something, filed/submitted/updated/logged something, given the customer a tool, or transferred them. Statements about what the CUSTOMER did do NOT count. (2) Across the WHOLE conversation: list every action YOU said you WILL do / are about to do (e.g. 'I will file the disputes') that you have NOT completed yet. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"claims": [{"kind": "search|verify|record_update|dispute_file|give|transfer|write", "what": "<5-10 words>", "tool": "<the exact name of the tool call in this conversation that performed it, or omit if no tool performed it>"}], "pending": [{"kind": "search|verify|record_update|dispute_file|give|transfer|write", "what": "<5-10 words>", "tool": "<the exact tool name you would need to call for it, or omit if none>"}]} — empty lists if none. Choose the MOST SPECIFIC kind that fits (record_update for changing a stored record's values, dispute_file for filing/submitting a dispute or report); use the generic "write" ONLY when no specific kind applies.

_source: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001 (How can I close a credit card account?)
procedures._quote_order: Check these in order: 1. Pending disputes … 2. No pending replacement cards … 3. Minimum account age … 4. Outstanding balance.
procedures._note_enforce: 정책이 Step 1에서 '이 순서로 확인하라'고 명령하고 Step 2가 그 다음임을 지정하므로 순서 강제의 허가가 있다. 허가 문장이 없으면 표면화만 한다.

enter_when._note: 이 절차에만 있는 도구로 진입한다. 공용 read(분쟁 이력·교체 주문)는 진입시키지 않는다 — x80이 잰 28건 과차단의 원인이 그것이었다.

nodes._quote: Pending disputes: The account must not have any active or pending transaction disputes.
No pending replacement cards: If a replacement has been ordered and not yet received or activated, a closure cannot proceed.
Use the get_closure_reason_history_8293 tool to determine whether this specific credit card account has any closure reason records within the past year.
Ask the customer why they want to close their account. Then log it using log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521.

Step 5: Make a Retention Offer — If the customer still wants to close after addressing their concerns, make one retention offer based on their card tier: Entry-tier 500 bonus points or a $5 statement credit; Mid-tier 2,000 or $20; Premium and above 5,000 or $50.

ledger_metrics._note_eligible: ★2026-08-08 신설 (C337·handoff §4·사용자 지시 *"상품 이름을 통일하라"* 후속). ★출처([[23]]) = **x150 절제 실측 + A3 조회**, gold 무참조. 실측: 같은 표를 주고 물으면 **0/5**(전부 자격 미달 상품을 고른다), **자격 미달 행을 미리 뺀 표**면 **5/5**. 축 이름을 문장으로 풀어써도 0/5, *"먼저 자격을 따지고 그 다음 최고를 고르라"* 고 분해해 줘도 0/5 ⇒ 표면화를 더 얹는 길은 닫혀 있고 **거르는 일 자체를 엔진이** 해야 한다(등대 §1.4 F2b·처방 = 형식화(LLM)→결정론 실행(filter)). ★여기 있는 것은 **축 이름뿐이고 값은 하나도 없다** — 값은 전부 A3 조회라 상품이 늘어도 이 선언은 안 자란다([[50]] ADB). ★거르는 축은 **우리가 결정론으로 쥔 둘뿐**이다(경과일 대 문턱·누계 대 상한). 그 축이 문서에 없는 상품은 **거르지 않고 그대로 싣는다** — 모르는 것을 탈락으로 바꾸지 않으며, 문구가 그 사실을 명시한다. ★**남은 축을 같이 싣는 이유**(자기정정): 통과 집합을 이름+보너스로 줄이면 099가 닫히지 않는다 — 관계기간 2년이라 문턱이 아무도 못 거르고, A3 실측상 `True Blue` 350 > `World Blue` 300 이라 **보너스만 주면 argmax 가 오답을 가리킨다**. 그 sim 을 가르는 것은 예치 하한(손님 $30,000 대 True Blue 50000·Beige 100000)이고, 5/5 를 낸 표에는 그 축이 들어 있었다. ⇒ 걸러 주되 **판단 재료는 빼앗지 않는다**([[05]] Q2: 고르는 것은 모델). ★정렬은 **이름순**이다 — 보너스순으로 내리면 첫 줄이 곧 답이 되어 우리가 argmax 까지 해 버린다. 측정된 조건(P2 표)도 이름순이었다. ⚠Δspurious(등대 §1.3): 발화가 길어진다. 그래서 발화 조건을 좁게 뒀다 — **경과일이 없거나 문턱 축이 비면 침묵**한다(문턱을 못 걸고 만든 '통과 집합'은 전체 표에 통과 도장을 찍는 것이고, 실측상 그 상태의 최고액이 정확히 오답 `World Blue` 300 이었다). ★★**문구는 실측으로 정해졌다**(x151 3라운드·유료 0·로컬 32B·n=5). 1차 초안(머리말 *"…제외했고 이것들이 남았다"* + 꼬리말 *"고르는 건 당신 몫·모든 요건이 충족된 건 아니다"*)은 **레버를 뒤집었다** — 100 은 0/5 였고 **099 는 raw 표 4~5/5 를 0~1/5 로 떨어뜨렸다**. 부분 격리 결과 범인은 **꼬리말**이다: 행이 같을 때 머리말만 = 5/5, **꼬리말만 = 2/5**, 둘 다 = 0/5, 감싸는 말 없음 = 5/5. 안전 문구가 *"자격은 이미 처리됐다"* 로 읽혀 모델이 **자기 검사를 끄고** 보너스 argmax 로 간다(099 에서 예치 하한 50000 인 `True Blue` 를 $30,000 손님에게 20/20 로 골랐다). ⇒ 우리가 건 두 기준을 **이름으로 말하되 그 이상을 주장하지 않는** 한 줄만 남겼다(두 태스크 5/5 인 유일 조합). ⚠정직성 대가: 이 문구는 걸렀다는 사실은 말하지만 *무엇이 빠졌는지*는 말하지 않는다 — 빠진 쪽은 `ineligible_text`·`exhausted_text` 가 같은 반환에서 이름과 함께 말한다([[25]] 유일 근거원 오염 방지는 그쪽이 진다). ★열 순서도 실측이다: `qualifying_deposit_usd` 를 `annual_referral_limit` 뒤로 밀면 **줄 수·글자 수가 같은데도** 099 가 4/5 → 0/5 가 된다(그 축이 099 의 유일 판별자다). 순서를 바꾸지 말 것. ⚠**궤적 문맥이 붙으면 099 는 여전히 0/5** 다(ctx arm 전부) — 이 레버는 능력 결손(100)을 닫지 부하(099 자기-정박)를 닫지 않는다.

_note_name_rules: 2026-08-08 (C333·사용자 지시 *"유사어 관련 규칙을 따로 뽑아 보강하라"*). ★**표가 아니라 규칙이다.** 유사어 표는 상품 수 N에 비례해 자라지만([[50]] ADB) 형태어 규칙은 **형태어 수**(여기 4개)에만 비례하고 상품이 늘어도 안 자란다. ★출처([[23]]) = **코퍼스 실측**(gold 무참조): 698문서 census 결과 꼬리말이 상품마다 갈린다 — `Navy Blue Account`×9 · `True Blue Account`×10 · `Lime Green Account`×8 인데 `Cobalt Blue Account`×1 · `Hunter Green Account`×1 · **`World Blue Account`×0**(문서는 `World Blue International Checking`). DB `accounts.level` 자체도 `Cobalt Blue`·`Navy Blue`(꼬리말 없음)와 `Blue Account`·`Green Account`가 섞여 있다 ⇒ **원천 자체가 이름을 하나로 정하지 않았다**(정책 완결성 결함). ★그래서 규칙은 두 방향으로 대칭이다: 꼬리 형태어는 **동일성에 무관**하고, 머리 어구는 **축자 일치**여야 한다. 후자가 C316(`Light Green`↔`Light Blue` 오배정)의 재발 방지선이고, 유사어 표를 안 만드는 이유이기도 하다 — 표는 그 오배정을 조용히 박제한다. ★판단은 여전히 모델 몫이고 엔진은 실재 여부만 본다([[22]]). ★빈 답을 **정답으로 명시**한다: 기권을 벌하면 추측이 생긴다([[43]]). 문헌 근거 = 같은 모델이 유한 inventory 강제 매핑 82.3% vs 자유 서술 98%(`PRIOR_MAPPING_BOUNDARY_SCALE_2026_08_01` §4·원장 C277) — 접기를 요구하는 자리 자체가 병목이므로, 접되 **못 접을 자유**를 남긴다. 실측 표적: 099에서 손님의 business checking 3종(`Cobalt Blue Account`·`Hunter Green Account`·`Navy Blue Account`)이 전부 판정 불가로 떨어져 상한 산수가 무력화됐다.
name_rules: How to decide whether two names are the same product: the identity is the leading name phrase. Trailing product-form words - Account, Business Checking, International Checking, Checking - describe the form of the product, not which product it is, so they may differ freely: 'Navy Blue', 'Navy Blue Account' and 'Navy Blue Business Checking' are the same product. The leading name phrase itself must match word for word: 'Light Green' and 'Light Blue' are DIFFERENT products, and so are 'Green' and 'Green Fee-Free' - never pair names that merely look or sound alike. If more than one entry in the list would fit, or none clearly does, leave it empty; an empty answer is correct and useful, a guess is not.
